Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 94, verses 1–2:

Naming of the Surah

• It is called al-Sharh (The Expansion), because it opens with Allah's favour upon our Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), that He expanded his breast and thus prepared him for the highest ranks.

Among the Objectives of the Surah

• It mentions Allah's care for His Messenger (ﷺ): by expanding his breast with faith, purifying him from sins, and raising his station in this world and the Hereafter. This consoles the Messenger (ﷺ) for the harm he suffers from the wicked, gives him the glad tidings of ease after hardship, and reminds him (ﷺ) to devote himself to worshipping Allah after completing the delivery of the message, in gratitude to Allah for the blessings He bestowed upon him.

[Tafsir]

"Did We not expand for you your breast, O Prophet, for the laws of the religion, the call to Allah, and the adornment with noble character? And We relieved you thereby of your burden."
